status: User-selected Pista default despite the failed median spectral-error gate. Experimental pressure-only model; original voice remains a failure fallback, and prior model weights remain recoverable from Git history.
modelKind: Supervised regularized control-gated causal FIR regression, not a neural network

teacherSettings.upstream: same stock settings; add only the corrected reference exhaust

outputs: Two outlet listener-pressure contributions in Pa at 5 m, before directivity; no other sound sources

gateSource.definition: fixed centers, widths, powers and flowScale; no reclustering

optimizer.method: independent-run matrix-free LSQR; one augmented original-coefficient ridge

normalization.definition: N_baseline/N_effective * summed squared residuals + damping^2 * original-coefficient squared norm

runtimeStream.includes: JS packet copy, model, input and output resampling; excludes model load, loudness and directivity

export: 9 significant decimal digits after f32 conversion; runtime weights bit-identical, no fitted playback gain/EQ
limitations: The broader final test retains +3.97 dB at 200-400 Hz; matching that band is not established across all conditions.
Pooled final-test median absolute band error worsens from 1.06 to 1.83 dB; higher bands are underpredicted.
Selected model uses 38.15 seconds because the pre-recorded ranking prioritized worst validation bass error; this is not proof that 38.15 seconds is globally optimal.
Pressure only; no jet, turbo, intake, bay or mechanical noise. Improved teacher agreement is not independent real-car validation.
The reference solver's documented physical and small-perturbation limitations remain.
